title: Dental PPO Plans Coordination with a Primary Carrier on Prior-Level Corrections
content:
Coordination provision, Dental PPO Plans. The other-carrier adjustment of a line reprocessed after it was paid at the coinsurance of the plan held before an upgrade (a reprocessed prior-level line) follows the primary payment recorded on the decision it replaces, and so decides the patient share:

| Primary payment recorded | Plan's secondary payment method | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| Above 0.00 | Non-duplication | The normal benefit is reduced by the primary payment, never below zero |
| Above 0.00 | Standard coordination of benefits | The payment is limited to the allowed amount less the primary payment |
| None (0.00 or not recorded) | Either | No adjustment |

The reduction acts on the normal benefit, and the limit then applies to the payment, ahead of the annual-maximum ceiling.

| Plan | Secondary payment method |
|---|---|
| Preventive 750, Value 1000, Classic 1250 | Non-duplication |
| Plus 1500, Premier 2000, Elite 2500 | Standard coordination of benefits |

### Hypothetical figures
Normal benefit 214.80, allowed amount 288.40, primary payment 150.00:
- Classic 1250 (non-duplication): 214.80 less 150.00, which is 64.80.
- Plus 1500 (standard coordination): the limit is 288.40 less 150.00, which is 138.40, so 138.40.
